CustomField.label: Instrument Pair
CustomField.description: DeveloperName of the GTM_Assessment_Pair__mdt pack that scored this request, e.g. hubspot__mcn. Essential, not diagnostic: the pack decides what the eight slots ASKED, so without it a stored Section_Scores__c blob becomes unreadable the moment someone edits a pack -- a 2 against a key nobody can look up any more. With it, reopening a year-old readout still resolves the same chain and prints the same questions.
